title: The Fkh1 Forkhead Associated Domain Promotes ORC Binding to a Subset of DNA Replication Origins in Budding Yeast
authors: Timothy Hoggard; Allison J. Hollatz; Rachel Cherney; Catherine A. Fox
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母中Fkh1的FHA结构域促进ORC与DNA复制起点结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但聚焦复制起始而非TF-DNA转录结合，且方法为实验遗传学与ChIP-seq，无AI或物理模拟建模。
abstract: The pioneer event in eukaryotic DNA replication is binding of chromosomal DNA by the origin recognition complex (ORC), which directs the formation of origins, the specific chromosomal regions where DNA will be unwound for the initiation of DNA synthesis. In all eukaryotes, incompletely understood features of chromatin promote ORC-DNA binding. Here, we uncover a role for the Fkh1 (forkhead homolog) protein, and, in particular, its forkhead associated (FHA) domain in promoting ORC-origin binding and origin activity at a subset of origins in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. The majority of the FHA-dependent origins within the experimental subset examined contain a distinct Fkh1 binding site located 5’ of and proximal to their ORC sites (5’-FKH-T site). Epistasis experiments using selected FHA-dependent origins provided evidence that the FHA domain promoted origin activity through Fkh1 binding directly to this 5’ FKH-T site. Nucleotide substitutions within two of these origins that enhanced the affinity of their ORC sites for ORC bypassed these origins’ requirement for their 5’ FKH-T sites and for the FHA domain. Significantly, direct assessment of ORC-origin binding by ChIPSeq provided evidence that this mechanism affected ~25% of yeast origins. Thus, this study reveals a new mechanism to enhance ORC-origin binding in budding yeast that requires the FHA domain of the conserved cell-cycle transcription factor Fkh1.
abstract_zh: 真核生物DNA复制的起始事件是染色体DNA与起点识别复合物（origin recognition complex, ORC）的结合，该复合物指导复制起点的形成，即DNA将被解旋以启动DNA合成的特定染色体区域。在所有真核生物中，尚未完全理解的染色质特征促进ORC-DNA结合。在此，我们揭示了Fkh1（叉头同源）蛋白，特别是其叉头相关（forkhead associated, FHA）结构域，在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中促进ORC-起点结合及部分起点活性的作用。在所检查的实验子集中，大多数依赖FHA的起点包含一个独特的Fkh1结合位点，该位点位于其ORC位点的5'端且邻近（5'-FKH-T位点）。使用选定的依赖FHA的起点进行的上位性实验提供了证据，表明FHA结构域通过Fkh1直接结合该5' FKH-T位点来促进起点活性。其中两个起点内的核苷酸替换增强了其ORC位点对ORC的亲和力，从而绕过了这些起点对其5' FKH-T位点和FHA结构域的需求。重要的是，通过ChIPSeq直接评估ORC-起点结合提供了证据，表明该机制影响了约25%的酵母起点。因此，本研究揭示了一种新的机制，通过该机制，芽殖酵母中增强ORC-起点结合需要保守细胞周期转录因子Fkh1的FHA结构域。
